worst: A: summary is z-loss-only; omits OLMoE's other stability levers (QK-Norm, RMSNorm, init) and APXML's warning that too large a z-loss coefficient can itself destabilize
worst_summary_quote: Practitioner course material suggests a small coefficient, typically around 0.001 to 0.01
worst_page_quote: increases the risk of the z-loss dominating and causing instability
reader_gets_wrong: A reader would take z-loss as essentially the only reported MoE instability mitigation and miss QK-Norm, RMSNorm and initialization.
